description: This file is a script that analyzes source code files to identify raw fetch calls outside an allowlist in a project related to channel/plugin runtime validation. It uses TypeScript's AST parsing to locate fetch invocations, primarily for security/integrity checking.

methods.name: isRawFetchCall
methods.description: Determines if a given TypeScript AST expression node is a call to the fetch function (either global fetch or fetch via globalThis).

methods.name: findRawFetchCallLines
methods.description: Parses source content to locate lines where raw fetch calls are made, returning their line numbers.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that runs the call site guard analysis, identifying raw fetch calls outside the defined allowlist.
